command:
from pathlib import Path
import json, shardloom as sl
from shardloom import ShardLoomClient
client=ShardLoomClient.from_env(); smoke=client.smoke_check()
assert '/site-packages/shardloom/bin/' in str(smoke.resolved_cli_path), smoke.resolved_cli_path
assert smoke.cli_version=='0.2.3', smoke.cli_version
assert not smoke.fallback_attempted
ctx=sl.context(client=client)
source=Path('target/github-prerelease-channel-proof-v0.2.3/orders.csv').resolve()
source.write_text('id,label,amount\n1,alpha,8\n2,beta,15\n3,gamma,27\n')
expected=[{'id':2,'label':'beta','amount':15},{'id':3,'label':'gamma','amount':27}]
workflows=[ctx.read(source).filter(sl.col('amount')>=10).select('id','label','amount').limit(2)]
workflows += [ctx.sql(f"SELECT id, label, amount FROM '{source}' WHERE amount >= 10 LIMIT 2") for _ in range(2)]
for workflow in workflows:
    result=workflow.collect()
    assert result.runtime_execution and result.rows_projected==2 and not result.fallback_attempted and not result.external_engine_invoked
    values=json.loads(result.envelope.human_text.split(' values=',1)[1])['values']
    assert values==expected, values
unsupported=ctx.read(source).select('id').to_pandas()
assert unsupported.blocker_id and not unsupported.runtime_execution and not unsupported.fallback_attempted and not unsupported.external_engine_invoked
print(json.dumps({'bundled_cli':str(smoke.resolved_cli_path),'version':smoke.cli_version,'dataframe_values':expected,'repeated_sql_executions':2,'unsupported_blocker':unsupported.blocker_id,'fallback_attempted':False,'external_engine_invoked':False}))
